rules.title: Annual Rent Increase Limit under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) are limited to 3% for the period July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026. Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords cannot include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.summary_plain: If you rent a unit covered by Los Angeles' Rent Stabilization Ordinance, your landlord can only raise your rent by 3% between July 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026, and starting February 2, 2026, they cannot add extra increases for utilities.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquila una unidad cubierta por la Ordenanza de Estabilización de Alquileres de Los Ángeles, su arrendador solo puede aumentar su renta en un 3% entre el 1 de julio de 2025 y el 30 de junio de 2026, y a partir del 2 de febrero de 2026, no pueden agregar aumentos adicionales por servicios públicos.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.exemptions_text: Non-RSO properties are not covered by this rent increase limit.
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%. Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
